title: Long noncoding RNA as a biomarker for the prognosis of ischemic stroke: A protocol for meta-analysis and bioinformatics analysis.
authors: Fu, Jing; Yu, Qian; Xiao, Jun; Li, Suping
one_liner_zh: 该文是缺血性卒中预后相关的lncRNA meta分析与生物信息学方案，仅涉及转录因子数据库预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: As the most common type of cerebrovascular disease, ischemic stroke is the disturbance of cerebrovascular circulation caused by various factors, with complex pathogenesis. At present, the molecular mechanism of ischemic stroke is still unclear, and there lacks early diagnostic markers. Therefore, there is an urgent need to find effective preventive measures, active diagnostic methods and rapid treatment measures. In recent years, related studies have displayed that long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) is related to the prognosis of ischemic stroke. However, the results are not supported by some evidence. Therefore, in this study, meta-analysis was used to analyze the relationship between lncRNAs and the prognosis of ischemic stroke. In addition, we carried out bioinformatics analysis to study the action mechanism and related pathways of lncRNAs in ischemic stroke. METHODS: Literature search was operated on databases up to March 2021, including China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Chinese Biomedical literature Database, Chinese Scientific and Journal Database, Wan Fang database, Web of Science, PubMed, and EMBASE. The relationship between lncRNAs expression and survival outcome was estimated by hazard ratio (HR) and 95% confidence interval (CI). Meta-analysis was conducted on the Stata 16.0. Starbase v2.0 software predicts microRNAs (miRNAs) that interacts with lncRNAs. In addition, HMDD v2.0 database filters out miRNAs related to ischemic stroke. Furthermore, Consite transcription factor database was used to predict the transcription factors of each lncRNAs and miRNA. At the same time, the transcription factors related to ischemic stroke were screened out after intersection. miRwalk online software was applied to predict the target mRNA of each miRNA, and the common target genes were screened by consistent method. The molecular regulatory network map of lncRNAs in ischemic stroke was drawn. Based on the overlapping target genes, gene ontology (GO), Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), and protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis were carried out to explore the possible mechanism. RESULTS: The results of this meta-analysis would be submitted to peer-reviewed journals for publication. CONCLUSION: This study will provide evidence-based medical evidence for the relationship between lncRNA and the prognosis of ischemic stroke. What is more, bioinformatics analysis will provide ideas for the study of ischemic stroke mechanism. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The private information from individuals will not be published. This systematic review also should not damage participants' rights. Ethical approval is not available. The results may be published in a peer-reviewed journal or disseminated in relevant conferences. OSF REGISTRATION NUMBER: DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/QBZW6.
abstract_zh: 背景：作为最常见的脑血管疾病类型，缺血性脑卒中是由多种因素引起的脑血管循环障碍，其发病机制复杂。目前，缺血性脑卒中的分子机制尚不清楚，且缺乏早期诊断标志物。因此，迫切需要寻找有效的预防措施、积极的诊断方法和快速的治疗手段。近年来，相关研究表明，长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）与缺血性脑卒中的预后相关。然而，这些结果尚未得到充分证据支持。因此，本研究采用荟萃分析来探讨lncRNAs与缺血性脑卒中预后之间的关系。此外，我们进行了生物信息学分析，以研究lncRNAs在缺血性脑卒中中的作用机制及相关通路。方法：文献检索在截至2021年3月的数据库中进行，包括中国知网、中国生物医学文献数据库、中国科学引文数据库、万方数据库、Web of Science、PubMed和EMBASE。通过风险比（HR）和95%置信区间（CI）评估lncRNAs表达与生存结局之间的关系。荟萃分析使用Stata 16.0软件进行。Starbase v2.0软件预测与lncRNAs相互作用的微小RNA（miRNAs）。此外，HMDD v2.0数据库筛选出与缺血性脑卒中相关的miRNAs。进一步地，使用Consite转录因子数据库预测每个lncRNA和miRNA的转录因子，并通过交集筛选出与缺血性脑卒中相关的转录因子。应用miRwalk在线软件预测每个miRNA的靶向mRNA，并通过一致方法筛选共同靶基因。绘制了lncRNAs在缺血性脑卒中中的分子调控网络图。基于重叠靶基因，进行了基因本体论（GO）、京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析，以探索可能的作用机制。结果：本荟萃分析的结果将提交至同行评审期刊以供发表。结论：本研究将为lncRNA与缺血性脑卒中预后之间的关系提供循证医学证据。此外，生物信息学分析将为缺血性脑卒中机制的研究提供思路。伦理与传播：个人隐私信息不会公开。本系统评价也不应损害参与者的权利。伦理批准不可用。结果可能发表在同行评审期刊上或在相关会议上传播。OSF注册号：DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/QBZW6。
